title: Senior AI Business Analyst
description:
Senior AI Business Analyst

Our client is urgently looking for an experienced Senior Business Analyst, with good demonstrable experience with AI to join their team on an 18-month Fixed-Term basis.

Our client is looking to get AI embedded at scale – a more structured and measurable manner, into the delivery of our client’s services across the group.

This is a new role created to understand the current-state, end-to-end workflows and then propose how they can be enhanced using the latest tools and technology. Working closely with Subject Matter Experts (SMEs), you’ll be tracking how they really work – their processes, systems and habits – to help identify opportunities where they can be supported and enhanced using automation/AI capabilities.

You will be rewarded with an excellent salary, as well as a brilliant benefits package including, hybrid 2 days on-site, pension scheme (4% matched), 3x life cover, cash plan, sick pay, salary sacrifice and many, many more perks!

Senior AI Business Analyst – Key Skills:

  • Substantial experience (5+ years) as a business analyst in the Legal sector
  • Familiarity with legal practice management systems and tools; these may include Clio, Aderant, Jylo, Lexis Protégé, Copilot
  • Process and workflow analysis and mapping in collaboration with SMEs
  • Examples of process improvement projects where automation/AI has been leveraged
  • Effective use of mapping tools such as Lucid and subsequent clear and effective communication of the outputs
  • Monitoring and analysis of qualitative and quantitative inputs to maintain quality of service delivered
  • Strong stakeholder skills: the ability to work with subject matter experts to translate their workflows into testable AI proposals, and explain trade-offs and results clearly to senior, non-technical audiences
  • Ability to effectively leverage AI tools to accelerate analysis, prototyping, experimentation and development
  • Strong data literacy e.g. understanding the importance and challenges of building and maintaining consistent taxonomies
  • Awareness of confidentiality, privilege and data-protection considerations when applying AI to client data
  • Worked in agile teams
  • Comfort operating with autonomy in a new role, with the judgement to prioritise where AI can deliver the most value

Senior AI Business Analyst


Due to the volume of applications received for positions, it will not be possible to respond to all applications and only applicants who are considered suitable for interview will be contacted.

Proactive Appointments Limited operates as an employment agency and employment business and is an equal opportunities organisation

We take our obligations to protect your personal data very seriously. Any information provided to us will be processed as detailed in our Privacy Notice, a copy of which can be found on our website http://proactive.it/privacy-notice/
